name: full-banner
title: Full-Page Banner
description: Light-DOM full-screen takeover that fills the viewport with a single dominant message. Ten templates (maintenance/launch/restricted/offline + error-404/500/403 + success-submitted/completed/welcome) with bespoke inline illustrations, optional dark inverted scheme, and a configurable semantic heading level (h1/h2/h3). error-*/success-* keys add a status-tinted eyebrow + illustration while meaning stays in text. Slots: children -> actions row, meta prop -> meta line.
